questions.question_english: What is the legal status of an admission granted based on a forged birth certificate under the RTE Act?

key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Admission stands; age proof issues are handled administratively without denying education.

questions.question_english:
Read the following assertion (A) and reason (R) statements and select the correct option:
Assertion (A): No child shall be denied admission in a school for lack of age proof.
Reason (R): The RTE Act mandates that an affidavit from parents is the only legally acceptable document for age verification.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

questions.explanation_english: Section 14 states that no child shall be denied admission to a school for lack of age proof. While birth certificates, hospital records, or Anganwadi registers serve as standard proof, parents' self- declarations are also acceptable. Stating that an affidavit is the sole legally acceptable document is incorrect, as statutory rules permit flexible, non-restrictive proof options.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C है। RTE अधिनियम की धारा 14 स्पष्ट करती है कि आयु-प्रमाण उपलब्ध न होने के कारण बच्चे को प्रवेश से वंचित नहीं किया जा सकता। कारण गलत है, क्योंकि अधिनियम यह नहीं कहता कि माता-पिता का शपथपत्र ही एकमात्र स्वीकार्य दस्तावेज है। आयु प्रमाणित करने के लिए नियमों में निर्धारित विभिन्न दस्तावेज स्वीकार किए जा सकते हैं; दस्तावेज न होने पर भी बच्चे का प्रवेश रोका नहीं जाना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Section 14 states that no child shall be denied admission to a school for lack of age proof. While birth certificates, hospital records, or Anganwadi registers serve as standard proof, parents' self- declarations are also acceptable. Stating that an affidavit is the sole legally acceptable document is incorrect, as statutory rules permit flexible, non-restrictive proof options.

questions.question_english: What is the most appropriate reason why Section 36 of the RTE Act states that no prosecution for offenses under the Act (like capitation fees or screening) shall be instituted without the previous sanction of an officer authorized by the appropriate Government?
options_english: To protect schools from frivolous or malicious legal harassment.

questions.explanation_english: Section 36 mandates prior sanction from an authorized government officer before prosecuting offenses under the Act. This administrative safeguard prevents frivolous, arbitrary, or malicious litigation against school administrations, ensuring that legal prosecution is initiated only after official verification of statutory non-compliance by designated authorities.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) To protect schools from frivolous or malicious legal harassment.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the powers of the appropriate Government under Section 38 of the RTE Act:
I. The appropriate Government may, by notification, make rules for carrying out the provisions of the Act.
II. Every rule made by the State Government shall be laid before the State Legislature.
III. The appropriate Government cannot amend the Schedule of the Act. Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: Section 38 empowers the appropriate Government to make statutory rules for implementing the Act, requiring state rules to be laid before State Legislatures. However, Section 20 grants the power to amend the Schedule containing school norms exclusively to the Central Government by official notification.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I और II है। धारा 38 समुचित सरकार को अधिनियम के प्रावधानों को लागू करने के लिए नियम बनाने की शक्ति देती है; राज्य सरकार द्वारा बनाए गए नियम संबंधित राज्य विधानमंडल के समक्ष रखे जाते हैं। तीसरा कथन गलत है, क्योंकि अधिनियम केंद्र सरकार को अधिसूचना के माध्यम से अनुसूची में संशोधन करने की शक्ति देता है, जैसा कि धारा 38 के संबंधित प्रावधानों में वर्णित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Section 38 empowers the appropriate Government to make statutory rules for implementing the Act, requiring state rules to be laid before State Legislatures. To prefer norm-referenced testing so as to encourage competition among classmates.
To require international norm-referenced testing in every grade.
To prohibit all forms of classroom testing and assessment.
questions.explanation_english: It favors competency-based testing so children reach learning goals without relative ranking. Section 29 promotes criterion-referenced, competency-based evaluation over traditional norm-referenced testing. Criterion-referenced assessment evaluates whether a child has achieved specific learning outcomes independently, eliminating relative peer ranking, reducing academic anxiety, and fostering mastery-oriented learning environments aligned with continuous evaluation goals.

questions.question_english: A child applies for admission to a school three months after the commencement of the academic session. As the Principal, what is your statutory obligation under Section 15 of the RTE Act?
options_english: Deny admission on the grounds that the statutory extended period for session admission has fully lapsed.
Admit the child, subject to the condition that they pass a basic readiness test.
Admit the child and offer special training if needed to complete studies.
Advise the parents to officially wait for the next academic session to prevent mid-year cumulative learning loss.
questions.explanation_english: Section 15 provides that a child shall be admitted to school even if admission is sought after the extended period. No child can be denied admission regardless of when entry is requested during the academic session. To ensure academic continuity, the school must admit the child and provide necessary special training to bridge learning gaps.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर बच्चे को प्रवेश देकर आवश्यकता के अनुसार विशेष प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध कराना है। धारा 15 का उद्देश्य सत्र शुरू होने के बाद आवेदन करने वाले बच्चे को केवल देरी के कारण शिक्षा से वंचित होने से बचाना है। विद्यालय को प्रवेश से इनकार नहीं करना चाहिए और न ही प्रवेश को तैयारी-परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने की शर्त से बाँधना चाहिए। यदि बच्चे की सीखने की स्थिति के अनुसार आवश्यकता हो, तो विशेष प्रशिक्षण की व्यवस्था की जानी चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Admit the child and offer special training if needed to complete studies.

Section 15 provides that a child shall be admitted to school even if admission is sought after the extended period. No child can be denied admission regardless of when entry is requested during the academic session. To ensure academic continuity, the school must admit the child and provide necessary special training to bridge learning gaps.

options_hindi: प्रशासनिक संसाधनों के अनुकूल उपयोग के लिए सभी उच्च प्राथमिक विद्यालयों को चरणबद्ध तरीके से बंद करके एकीकृत करना

questions.question_english: The requirement to establish neighbourhood schools within a specified timeframe has led to which of the following systemic changes in state education infrastructure?
options_english: Phased closure and consolidation of all upper primary schools to optimize state administrative resources.
Upgrading primary schools and opening new schools in unserved habitations.
Complete privatization and outsourcing of state elementary schools located in difficult geographical terrains.
Shifting the delivery of elementary education entirely to open-schooling and distance- learning modes.
questions.explanation_english: The statutory mandate to establish neighbourhood schools within defined walking distances led to widespread expansion of state educational infrastructure. State Governments upgraded existing lower primary facilities into full upper primary institutions and opened new public schools in previously unserved rural and remote habitations, ensuring physical accessibility to elementary schooling for all children across diverse geographical regions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर प्राथमिक विद्यालयों का उन्नयन और विद्यालय-विहीन बस्तियों में नए विद्यालय खोलना है। पड़ोस के विद्यालय का उद्देश्य बच्चों को उनके निवास के निकट शिक्षा उपलब्ध कराना है। जहाँ निर्धारित दूरी के भीतर विद्यालय नहीं है, वहाँ आधारभूत संरचना का विस्तार या उन्नयन आवश्यक हो सकता है। निजीकरण या सभी विद्यालय बंद करने जैसे कदम इस वैधानिक उद्देश्य से मेल नहीं खाते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Upgrading primary schools and opening new schools in unserved habitations.

The statutory mandate to establish neighbourhood schools within defined walking distances led to widespread expansion of state educational infrastructure. State Governments upgraded existing lower primary facilities into full upper primary institutions and opened new public schools in previously unserved rural and remote habitations, ensuring physical accessibility to elementary schooling for all children across diverse geographical regions.

questions.question_english: What is the primary reason the RTE Act includes "disaster relief duties" as one of the permissible non-educational duties for teachers?
options_english: Disasters require mobilizing all available public personnel for emergency relief.
Teachers possess specialized professional certification in emergency search and rescue operations.
Public school buildings represent the only structurally safe emergency shelters during natural disasters.
Emergency relief deployment generates significant additional grant revenue for the education department.
questions.explanation_english: Section 27 restricts non-educational deployment of teachers to essential civic duties. Including disaster relief recognizes that major natural calamities or public emergencies require rapid mobilization of public servants to provide immediate humanitarian assistance, shelter management, and relief operations under direct state disaster management frameworks.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है। आपदा जैसी असाधारण परिस्थिति में राहत और सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा के लिए प्रशासन को विभिन्न विभागों के कर्मियों की सहायता लेनी पड़ सकती है। धारा 27 सामान्य गैर-शैक्षिक तैनाती को सीमित करती है, लेकिन जनगणना, चुनाव और आपदा राहत जैसे निर्दिष्ट कार्यों को अपवाद के रूप में मान्यता देती है। इसका कारण शिक्षकों का आपदा-बचाव में विशेष प्रशिक्षण होना नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Disasters require mobilizing all available public personnel for emergency relief.

Section 27 restricts non-educational deployment of teachers to essential civic duties. Including disaster relief recognizes that major natural calamities or public emergencies require rapid mobilization of public servants to provide immediate humanitarian assistance, shelter management, and relief operations under direct state disaster management frameworks.

questions.question_english: Section 5 of the RTE Act provides for the right of transfer to other schools. If a child's parent is transferred to another state, the child has the right to:
options_english: Seek transfer to another school, and the Head Teacher must immediately issue the certificate.
Demand free long-distance travel and airfare relocation allowances directly from the school.
Remain in the original school's residential hostel with full tuition and boarding fee waivers.
Formally discontinue elementary education without incurring any administrative penalty.
questions.explanation_english: Section 5 guarantees that where a child is required to move from one school to another, they have the right to seek transfer. The Head Teacher of the sending institution is legally obligated to issue the Transfer Certificate immediately, ensuring no delay hinders continuous educational enrollment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर दूसरे विद्यालय में स्थानांतरण माँगने और स्थानांतरण प्रमाणपत्र तुरंत जारी किए जाने का अधिकार है। धारा 5 का उद्देश्य परिवार के स्थान बदलने पर बच्चे की शिक्षा में निरंतरता बनाए रखना है। प्रधान शिक्षक द्वारा स्थानांतरण प्रमाणपत्र जारी करने में देरी नहीं की जानी चाहिए। अधिनियम सामान्य रूप से हवाई यात्रा भत्ता या मूल विद्यालय में छात्रावास का अधिकार प्रदान नहीं करता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Seek transfer to another school, and the Head Teacher must immediately issue the certificate.

Section 5 guarantees that where a child is required to move from one school to another, they have the right to seek transfer. The Head Teacher of the sending institution is legally obligated to issue the Transfer Certificate immediately, ensuring no delay hinders continuous educational enrollment.
